description.en: Our very best TV package that offers a world of premium entertainment, including movies, sports, music and specialty channels. Over 315 channels. Every premium movie channel included Over 35 specialty sports channels included. Local channels included. Eligibility based on service address. Now includes live 4K – Enjoy amazing live entertainment in stunning life-like clarity. To view your current package price, including extras and discounts, view your most recent statement

termsAndConditions.en: Does this replace my current package? Yes, this will replace your current package. How much will I be charged? On your next bill, you'll see a credit for the package that you're disconnecting today because you paid in advance. You'll also see a partial charge that covers the new package starting today, and the regular monthly charge that we bill in advance for the following month. How long does activation take? 5 minutes.
